title: Excavations in Palestine in 1931: The 'Irq el Ahmar Rock-shelter
author: (round-up; sounding by R. Neuville)
screen_term: Wadi Khureitun, near Umm Qatafa (spelling of gazetteer 'khareitun'; 'umm qatafa')
location_note: In Wadi Khureitun, 2 km west of Umm Qatafa cave; no map reference; placed by name. Not a held cave area.
notes: May 1931 sounding: levels A (Early and Middle Bronze sherds and a Middle Bronze hearth) to F (Levallois-type flakes, human and animal remains). Same rock-shelter as QDAP2-185 (next season); not deduplicated.

features.subtype: rock-shelter with stratified deposits, Aurignacian to Middle Bronze Age
features.period: Palaeolithic to Early and Middle Bronze Ages (levels F to A)
features.quote: a sounding in the Irg el Ahmar rock-shelter, situated in the Wadi
